accueil.texte: Every card is a player of the big five leagues. His rating each gameweek is computed on the match he really played. His value starts from the player's real market value and follows his performances; his price is yours to make, on the market.
accueil.1: Open packs with your €30M and your starting squad. Every card exists in only a few copies.
accueil.2: Trade on the market: auction the cards that rise, buy the ones others underrate.
accueil.3: Your team plays live against a manager of your level, or a campaign in a real competition, with your cards' attributes.

slot.hors_poste: Out of position: −{malus} on each of his attributes during the match.
slot.mieux_ici: His attributes are worth more here than at his position: +{bonus} on each during the match.
consigne.lateraux.couloir.aide: The full-back joins the attack on his wing. The neutral setting.
consigne.lateraux.bas.aide: He does not cross the halfway line: +defending, −penetration.
consigne.lateraux.axe.aide: Inverted full-back: one more man in the middle. +control, −defending.
consigne.ailiers.equilibre.aide: He alternates outside and inside runs. The neutral setting.
consigne.ailiers.ligne.aide: He keeps the width and stretches their block: +penetration, −creation.
consigne.ailiers.interieur.aide: Inverted winger, he comes in to shoot: +creation, +finishing, −penetration.
consigne.milieux.equilibre.aide: He goes up and down with the play. The neutral setting.
consigne.milieux.projection.aide: He bursts into the box: +penetration, −defending (the space behind).
consigne.milieux.lateral.aide: He moves the play to the wings: +creation, −control (the middle empties).
consigne.attaquants.equilibre.aide: He plays between the lines and in behind. The neutral setting.
consigne.attaquants.profondeur.aide: Runs behind the defence: more balls played, worse ones: +penetration, −creation.
consigne.attaquants.pivot.aide: Back to goal, he holds and lays off: +control, +creation, −penetration.
consigne.relance.equilibre.aide: We play out as we can. The neutral setting.
consigne.relance.courte.aide: We play out cleanly but we expose ourselves: +control, −defending.

ajuster.texte: A change takes effect at the next minute: it never touches what has already been played.
consignes.texte_match: What you ask of each line. Each one is a trade, never a bonus, and it shows on the pitch: a full-back who stays back no longer overlaps, a winger who cuts inside leaves the flank.
dialogue.exemples: “press high”, “Hakimi, stay back”, “Kolo Muani replaces Dembélé”…
causerie.dite.secouer: At the break, you shook them up.
causerie.dite.rassurer: At the break, you reassured them.
causerie.dite.feliciter: At the break, you praised them.
causerie.dite.rien: At the break, you left them be.
causerie.titre: Half-time — what do you tell them?
causerie.texte: What you say is not worth the same depending on the score. The effect lasts {n} minutes, and you only speak once.
causerie.secouer.aide: Urgency, less composure. It works mostly when you are behind.
causerie.rassurer.aide: Composure, less drive. It holds a result, it does not turn one around.
causerie.feliciter.aide: It works when things go well. When they go badly, it is off the mark and it lulls them.
marquage.texte: Put a man on one of theirs. He weighs less — all the less when he is strong — but the one following him spends his match following him. Only worth it against a real danger.
tireurs.texte: Penalties: {penalty} · corners: {corner} — the best finisher and the best creator of your eleven.

profil.aucune_preference: No marked preference: he is equally at ease everywhere, the mark of a complete player — which means no tactic will make him play above himself.
profil.texte: Read from his attributes, compared with his line's: what he does better than the others at his position, not his level. A tactic that suits him makes him play up to {pct} % above himself; one that hinders him, as much below.
profil.a_son_niveau: With your starting tactic, he plays at his level.
profil.au_dessus: With your starting tactic, he plays above himself ({pct} % on his attributes).
profil.en_dessous: With your starting tactic, he plays below himself ({pct} % on his attributes).
fiche.potentiel_titre: What the card can reach this season: its start plus what its age lets it gain (young players climb higher, older ones drop lower)
fiche.valeur_inconnue: Real market value unknown: price estimated from the OVR
fiche.ovr_texte: The OVR is the quality over the season, bounded to ±10 from the start. The price doubles every +8 OVR, and rises with the share of teams owning the card.
detail.texte: Everything comes from the engine's “Ballon d'or” scale: every action of every match, weighted by competition, round and opponent, read per 90 minutes. Nothing is drawn at random.
detail.mediane_note: median {mediane} · your sample weighs {poids} ({k} min of reference)
detail.role_note: {tit} starts over {feuilles} sheets → {part}, against {ref} for a typical starter
detail.2_saison: 2. What the current season makes of it
detail.aucune_journee: No gameweek played since the start: the card is still at its starting OVR.
detail.saison_note: over {min} min, {tit} starts · last season still counts for {poids}
detail.ramene_limite: pulled back within the ±{n} points limit
detail.attributs_texte: Each axis is the sum of the points the scale gives to his actions, per 90 minutes, ranked among ALL regular outfield players — a defender's dribbling is compared with a winger's, not with the other defenders'.
detail.parmi_reguliers: among the season's regulars, all positions together → {valeur}
solo.accroche: Take a club's place and play its season
solo.choisis_texte: You replace a club of the competition and play its fixtures with your eleven. The opponents are the real clubs, lined up with their players' cards: when a player drops, his club drops with him. The further you go, the more you earn.

compte.limites_texte: Free tier: 2 campaign or challenge matches a day, 2 running auctions, one Bronze pack a day. Ranked is never limited. Premium lifts these limits, gives three packs a day and +25 % match bonuses. Never a card that only money gives.
